name: The Moss-twined Heart

narrative.details:
The heart of Blackmoss the Fetid is covered with a dark, oily moss.  In fact, the only way to tell this is a heart is from its slow, rhythmic beat... A beat that continues even now.

Perhaps Denalan will want to see this heart.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Moss-twined Heart to Denalan at Lake Al'Ameth.
narrative.offerRewardText:
...What is this? A timberling heart?? It's covered with a foul moss!

Thank you for bringing this to me, adventurer. I will examine the heart and, if fortune shines, determine the nature of the moss about it.
narrative.requestItemsText: adventurer! You have something for me?
